verdict.rationale: Anrok documents a real-time tax calculation API: createEphemeral returns the tax to collect for checkout previews. It also has an Address Resolution endpoint that normalizes a customer address and returns its taxable jurisdictions, which implies address-based rather than ZIP-based lookup. Missing for 10: an explicit rooftop/address-level accuracy claim (vs ZIP approximation), documented latency or performance figures suitable for inline checkout, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can calculate the right sales tax for a transaction through an API in real time — address-level (rooftop) accuracy, not ZIP-code approximations — fast enough to sit inside checkout

citations.quote: It's common to show a preview of the tax amount on a checkout page before the customer completes their order. This tax amount can be estimated using Anrok's createEphemeral endpoint
This endpoint accepts the details of your transaction and returns the tax amount to collect.
The Anrok Address Resolution endpoint resolves a customer address to its normalized form, suitable for sales tax calculations, as well as taxable jurisdiction(s).
Use Anrok's Transactions API to synchronize transactions between Anrok and your billing system, as well as calculate sales tax for new invoices.
